metadata.description: Five Claude Code mods for running several sessions at once: a fleet board, a PR-to-production tracker, rule tripwires, a side-effects ledger and a context gauge.

plugins.name: session-fleet
plugins.description: Fleet board of live sessions, a needs-you beacon, and a worktree claim guard, shared across sessions

plugins.name: ship-tracker
plugins.description: Ship-pipeline band (PR, CI, merge, prod deployment, live) and a receipt line under each turn

plugins.name: session-hygiene
plugins.description: Tripwires for Ben's memory rules, and a handoff card of open loops left by earlier sessions

plugins.name: session-activity
plugins.description: Side-effects ledger (/ledger) with a hold on production SQL writes, and a waiting-on tracker for background work

plugins.name: context-gauge
plugins.description: Context-window gauge with a pre-compaction warning, and a log of what was in flight at each compaction
